title: Taking up string bass and tenor banjo
summary: Hired as bass player by Manuel Perez's Imperial band after Billy Moran left; self-taught on bass, about ten years on tenor banjo.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: Tenor band, yeah. When did you take up the bass? I had taken up the bass after I put the tenor band on. I had taken up the bass. They hired me, what you call, Emmanuel Perez, them. They had some misunderstanding with Billy Moran, the bass player. Yes. And they led Billy Moran. It was Imperial Band. Huh? It was Imperial. Imperial Band. They hired me and I stayed with them.
Did you have any lessons on the string bass or did you pick that up?
No, I didn't have no. I just picked it up.
Well, how long were you on that? Did you play that tenor band, Joe, I think?
Yes. Well, I did get the lesson from the young man showed me from the office. He gave me about four lessons on the tenor banjo. He gave me the fingerboard.
And how many years did you play the tenor banjo?
Oh, I played that tenor banjo ten years or so.
